payload.body: dc: ST0002 WP04's local half, measured so far. (1) The render. In my scratch clone at main 42aa87e I made a local annotated tag v2.0.0, because render takes only an annotated tag. It is the clone's alone, never pushed, and goes when I finish. The SHA256SUMS comes from shasum over three stand-in tarballs named as formula.assets lists them, so nothing is typed, but the sums are of stand-ins, not of release assets. bin/devbin formula render v2.0.0 <out> --sums <file> exits 0. (2) brew style, in a scratch local tap dc/pplrscratch: a path outside a tap draws Sorbet and frozen-string cops that a tap's Formula/ does not, and audit needs a tap anyway. It exits 1 with one offense: Layout/LineLength 131/118 on the manifest header that devbin generates (lib/cmd/formula:424). The two long Linux url lines pass, since RuboCop allows a URI, and everything the template holds passes. (3) The RuboCop wrap fails. Homebrew refuses disable directives (Style/DisableCopsWithinSourceCodeDirective twice, Cop/DisableComment once), so no template change can fix it. The line is 122 columns plus the name and the version, so every assets formula fails brew style. The fix is devbin's: the header one element per line, with a trailing comma. I measured that shape on the render: brew style exits 0 with no offenses, and the manifest's bytes are unchanged. The Devbin issue text for hv (your hold 2, item 7), not filed, is at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Pplr/da774a51-7916-4f68-b76b-37c788cb4a76/scratchpad/render/devbin-issue.md. (4) brew audit --strict is blocked by Homebrew itself: 'Refusing to load formula dc/pplrscratch/pplr from untrusted tap'. brew trust --formula dc/pplrscratch/pplr would let it run; it is one entry in ~/.homebrew/trust.json, removed by brew untrust. That is hv's security setting, so I am asking hv. (5) No AT proposal yet, because AC-04.1 rests on three things. The render (nothing typed) is measured. style rests on the Devbin fix, and audit on hv's answer about trust. The signatures (install and test re-verify every macOS binary against its requirement) need signed assets, your hold 2, item 3. The repo is untouched: the template change I tried lived in the clone and is reverted, and the scratch tap sits outside the repo, to be removed with brew untap.
